video_title: Oklahoma City Thunder 2026 Mock Offseason and Preview | Third Apron Podcast

quotes.speaker: Andrew Schlecht
quotes.summary_phrase: The Spurs' talented roster deserves credit for their series performance
quotes.excerpt: No matter how deep the Thunder are, this is a really talented Spurs roster that deserves credit.

text_blocks.speaker: Andrew Schlecht
text_blocks.text: If you told somebody before the series started that both AJ Mitchell and Jaylen Williams weren't going to be playing by the end of the series, they probably aren't going to win the series. That's how good the Spurs are. No matter how deep the Thunder are, this is a really talented Spurs roster that deserves credit.

text_blocks.speaker: Yossi Gozlan
text_blocks.text: The guys who stepped up for AJ Mitchell and for AJ Mitchell, we saw a lot more McCain, we saw a lot more Cason Wallace. Everyone stepped up, played really well.

quotes.speaker: Andrew Schlecht
quotes.summary_phrase: The Thunder are committed to Chet Holmgren long-term
quotes.excerpt: They have him locked in long-term. He's a guy that they believe in.
quotes.quote: A lot of people are talking about trades and all these things. I do not anticipate that at all. They have him locked in long-term. He's a guy that they believe in, that they believe will work through the difficulties that he's having in this series.

quotes.speaker: Andrew Schlecht
quotes.summary_phrase: Trading for Giannis Antetokounmpo would be a mistake for the Thunder
quotes.excerpt: Trading for Giannis complicates things in the short term and the long term for the Thunder.
quotes.quote: People want to talk about Giannis Antetokounmpo because it's the obvious thing. The Bucks are ready to move on from Giannis, and they need good young talent. It's not an illogical thought, I would say. But you are losing eight years there between Chet Holmgren and Giannis. Trading for Giannis complicates things in the short term and the long term for the Thunder.

quotes.speaker: Andrew Schlecht
quotes.summary_phrase: The Thunder's core four are non-negotiable moving forward
quotes.excerpt: It's Shai, it's Jaylen, it's Chet, it's AJ Mitchell. Those are the non-negotiable, those are your core four.
quotes.quote: It starts with four guys. It's Shai, it's Jaylen, it's Chet, it's AJ Mitchell. Those are the non-negotiable, those are your core four moving forward for the Thunder, and everyone else is expendable to a degree.

quotes.speaker: Andrew Schlecht
quotes.summary_phrase: Isaiah Joe and Aaron Wiggins are expendable rotation players
quotes.excerpt: I think it probably starts with Isaiah Joe and Aaron Wiggins as the guys that could go.
quotes.quote: I think it probably starts with Isaiah Joe and Aaron Wiggins as the guys that could go. They're still on value deals because they didn't play a lot, especially against the Spurs. You probably think of them as these aren't good players. These would be rotation players for almost anybody else.

quotes.speaker: Andrew Schlecht
quotes.summary_phrase: The Thunder must retain Isaiah Hartenstein at all costs
quotes.excerpt: I just think it's so obvious they have to keep Isaiah Hartenstein. They have to bring that guy back.
quotes.quote: I just think it's so obvious they have to keep Isaiah Hartenstein. They have to bring that guy back. He's super valuable to them. He was great against Wembanyama. He's a great regular season player. If you play Jokic again, you need him. If you play Wembanyama again, you need him. You just can't let that guy go.

quotes.speaker: Andrew Schlecht
quotes.summary_phrase: Alex Caruso is a more effective wing defender than most wings
quotes.excerpt: They have opted for guys like Alex Caruso, who they just think is a more effective wing defender.
quotes.quote: They have opted for guys like Alex Caruso, who they just think is a more effective wing defender than an actual wing is, which that's proven to be correct.
